text: Think of your cash cushion like a household pantry: the $80,000 on hand is enough to feed the family for 7.9 months, which shows your money is already working to give you momentum. If you set aside the $18,500 for the vacation and Ethan’s college, your pantry then covers 6.1 months; check the $750 left above your reserve to see how much extra wiggle room remains.
